enabled.description: Animate the flip and the roll. Off shows the result straight away, for a panel that cannot keep up.

flip_ms.description: How long the coin is in the air.

roll_ms.description: How long the dice tumble before the first one settles.

spin_ms.description: How long the wheel turns before it stops.

dice_collide.description: Let dice shove each other apart, and knock a settled one back into rolling. Never changes a result. Turn it off on a panel that struggles with a large roll.

frame_ms.description: Time between drawn frames. 33 is about 30 per second; raise it on a slow panel.

title_ms.description: How long a title banner is held before the coin appears.

result_ms.description: How long the result stays up for one thing - one coin, one die. More on the stage holds it longer.

result_per_item_ms.description: Added for each thing after the first.

result_max_ms.description: The longest it will ever hold, however much is on the stage.

wheel_bonus_ms.description: Added to a wheel's result, so it stays up long enough to look at where it stopped.

outcome_ms.description: How long an outcome banner stays up after the result.

speak_result.description: Say the result out loud as well as showing it.

remember_results.description: Keep every flip and roll in the notification history. No toast either way - the result is already on screen.
